premises.text: Cookie is a push-button automated cooking device that cooks fresh home meals from pre-portioned ingredient trays using robotics, like a Keurig for cooking
premises.evidence_span: Cookie, a push-of-a-button automated cooking device from Serenity Kitchen. Think of it as a Keurig for cooking fresh food using robotics

premises.text: College students have limited time and cooking ability and less access to home-cooked meals
premises.evidence_span: We'll have limited time and ability to make food. Many of us don't know how to cook, and being away from home, we'll have less access to these home-cooked meals

premises.text: Cookie implements cooking via food-tray storage/delivery, induction cooktop, and a robotic arm for manipulation
premises.evidence_span: Cookie captures these things with a storage and delivery mechanism for food trays, a safe induction cooktop, and of course, the robotic arm

premises.text: Foodie app connects users to recipes, a recipe store, scheduling, tips, and cooking progress; chefs can teach recipes and motions
premises.evidence_span: Foodie presents a clean, simple interface to connect a user with his or her food choices. Foodie also presents a way to access our upcoming recipe store to buy food and recipes

premises.text: Meals are about $4, Cookie retails at $600 or can be rented via subscription, competing on price with mid-tier frozen meals while using fresh ingredients
premises.evidence_span: A Serenity meal is typically priced at around $4 per meal. The app is free, and cookie will retail at $600. A consumer can also rent the machine with a monthly subscription for a substantially reduced initial cost

premises.text: Pre-portioned healthy meal kits reduce work, cut household food waste, and encourage healthier eating
premises.evidence_span: By pre-portioning just the right amount of healthy fresh ingredients into meal kits and reducing the amount of work required to prepare these meals, we not only help save people time, but we also help conserve food and encourage healthier eating habits

value.text: Cook a fresh recipe meal from a database without picking up a spatula, by pushing a button
value.evidence_span: now we can cook a recipe meal from a recipe database without picking up a spatula

secondary_value.text: Conserve food and encourage healthier eating via pre-portioned kits
secondary_value.evidence_span: we also help conserve food and encourage healthier eating habits

causal_links.evidence_span: limited time and ability to make food
connect a user with his or her food choices
pre-portioning just the right amount of healthy fresh ingredients

notes: Crowdfunding ask excluded. Demo failures ignored. Soft count 6 near upper typical range; chef-teaching folded into Foodie premise.

meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.2; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.
